conclusion.interpretation: Existing grouped logs do not certify group-specific valid PPO exposure. This is a measurement limit, not evidence that excluded transitions were optimized or that ordinary forward/backward groups actually had any excluded transitions.

masked_returns_and_capture_order.masks_copied: recovery_rollout.py:71-82 validates and stores policy_learning_mask and policy_bootstrap_mask for each native transition.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.attachment: train_chassis.py:119-125 and 810-812 attaches when recovery_training or nonstandard_start is enabled, then binds original_update to the adapter update.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.all_valid_and_bootstrap_valid_branch: recovery_rollout.py:102-105 delegates native returns; no excluded transitions in this branch.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.mixed_or_bootstrap_boundary_branch: recovery_rollout.py:110-131 constructs masked GAE. Local values=where(valid,storage.values,0), rewards=where(valid,storage.rewards,0), invalid returns=0 and invalid advantages=0. Bootstrap also requires the next learning frame, next bootstrap mask and no done.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.normalization: If normalize_advantage_per_mini_batch is false, lines128-130 use mean/std of advantages[valid] only, then restore invalid advantages to zero. If true, this adapter does not normalize at this stage. This bounded audit does not establish the actual flag value or independently re-audit downstream native normalization.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.capture_before_compaction: train_chassis.py:846-848 runs LearningAudit.capture before original_update. recovery_rollout.py:146-153 compacts only inside original_update, after this capture.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.true_optimizer_population: recovery_rollout.py:140-155 either delegates an entirely learning-valid buffer or selects learning.flatten().nonzero() and compacts observations/rewards/actions/dones/values/log_prob/returns/advantages/distribution parameters before native PPO.
masked_returns_and_capture_order.residual_caveat: LearningAudit.capture subtracts original storage.values, not the local masked values used in GAE. In the masked branch an excluded item has zero return; for a finite original value its logged residual is -storage.values. The grouped residual therefore is not a learning-valid-only critic residual.

limits: No saved events or current model were read in this audit; the new conclusions are frozen-source semantics, not new numerical observations.
Whole-rollout valid/excluded counts cannot be allocated to forward_05/backward_05 using these tags. Neither positive nor zero excluded frame counts for either group are established.

Rewards in excluded physical transitions may be gated by native reward logic; the audit only proves their grouped logging denominator is not filtered by policy_learning_mask. It does not infer their values.
Logged physical reward payment and stored advantages do not guarantee a policy gradient direction or useful policy learning.

This report requests no code, logging, training or gate change. The minimum missing datum for a valid-exposure attribution is the existing learning mask summed over each group within the same rollout; it is not present in the grouped persisted tags.
